title: Provider-side corpus veto: a manifest field that would suppress the community corpus about the package it ships with

violation.message: the manifest carries a registry suppression field; the corpus about a package is the ecosystem judgment, not the package own, so a provider may never suppress or veto it, and only the consumer can reverse precedence

suppression.effect: would suppress the community corpus published for this package, which no provider-side mechanism may do in either direction

steps.step: Static discovery reads the provider declaration. Version and level are exactly right, and alongside them sits a field that tells the router to ignore the community corpus.

registry.note: we maintain our own answers, do not load the community corpus for this package
